description: This file defines a Java class 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' which implements filtering for logging purposes. It filters log messages to only pass the message content to the next log node, omitting metadata like tags or priorities. It is used in Android logging frameworks to simplify log output.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode implementation that filters logs to only pass through the message content, skipping metadata.
